sloka: सुलोहिततलौ श्लक्क्षणौ चरणौ सुप्रतिष्ठतौ ।दृष्ट्वा ताम्रनखौ तस्या दीप्यते मे शरीरजः ॥६-१२-१५॥।।
transliteration: sulohitatalau ślakkṣaṇau caraṇau supratiṣṭhatau ।dṛṣṭvā tāmranakhau tasyā dīpyate me śarīrajaḥ ॥6-12-15॥।।

translations.english: "Beholding her smooth red soles and evenly shaped pinkish nails of feet, love is kindled in me."
